article.title: Enrolled and registered persons to act as insolvency professionals.
article.content: No person shall render his services as insolvency professional under this Code without being enrolled as a member of an insolvency professional agency and registered with the Board.
article.html:
206Enrolled and registered persons to act as insolvency professionals.

Section 206 · Part IV · Chapter IV · page 134 of the Act

No person shall render his services as insolvency professional under this Code without being enrolled as a member of an insolvency professional agency and registered with the Board.
